title.en: Build BRD, FRD, User Stories & BPMN

prompt.en:
Based on the available project materials @Requirements @Meeting notes, including:
1. ==Stakeholder inputs:== business brief, meeting notes, plus relevant email conversations retrieved from my Gmail, including threads with sarah.mitchell@acme.com and david.chen@acme.com
2. ==Pre-sales handover:== project background, proposed solution, and key requirements and current process image captured during pre-sales
3. ==My own analysis:== initial research, requirement analysis, and working notes
4. ==Previous cases:== similar past projects retrieved from Google Drive for reference on structure, framework, terminology, and document styling
Please consolidate and clarify the requirements, ==identify gaps or open questions==, and ==generate a complete requirements package== including the BRD, FRD, User Stories with acceptance criteria, and an end-to-end business process flow. ==Ensure all deliverables are consistent.==
prompt.zh:
基于以下现有项目材料 @Requirements @Meeting notes：
1. ==相关方输入：==业务简介、会议纪要，以及从我的 Gmail 中检索到的相关邮件往来，包括与 sarah.mitchell@acme.com 和 david.chen@acme.com 的邮件往来
2. ==售前交接材料：==项目背景、方案建议，以及售前阶段整理的关键需求和现状流程图
3. ==我自己的分析：==前期调研、需求分析和工作笔记
4. ==历史案例：==从 Google Drive 检索到的类似历史项目，用于参考结构、框架、术语和文档风格
请帮我整合并厘清需求，==识别其中的缺口或待澄清问题==，并==生成一套完整的需求包==，包括 BRD、FRD、带验收标准的用户故事，以及端到端的业务流程图。==确保所有交付物之间保持一致。==

reply.en: Consolidated all sources, flagged 4 open questions, and generated a consistent BRD, FRD, User Stories, and process flow.
reply.zh: 已整合全部材料，识别出 4 处待澄清问题，并生成了一套相互一致的 BRD、FRD、用户故事和业务流程图。
